PHAN II. CHUAN DAU RA CUA CHUONG TRINH DAO TAO
1. Chuan dau ra ve kien thurc (K)
K1. Phan tich dugc anh huong cua lich su, van hoa, nghe thuat, triet hoc, cac
he tu tuong, the che chinh tri, mo hinh xa hoi, dieu kien ty nhien, kinh té, trinh do
ky thuat cong nghe den hinh thai cong trinh xay dung;
K2. Van dung duoc kien thuc lien nganh ve van hoa, xa hoi, nghe thuat, moi
truong, vat lieu va cong nghe trong viec thyc hien cac dy an kien truc va canh quan;
K3. Ap dung dugc cac nguyen ly, tieu chuan ve thiet ke va quy hoach trong
viec thyc hien cac dy an kien truc va canh quan.
2. Chuan dau ra ve ky nang (S)
S1. Phan tich dugc nhu cau, van de cu the cua khach hang va cong dong trong
linh vuc kien truc va canh quan;
S2. Dong gop dugc cac y kién tu van va phan bien phu hop cho khach hang
cung nhu cong dong;
S3. De xuat duoc giai phap hieu qua va sang tao cho cac van de gap phai khi
thuc hien du an nham dam bao cac yeu cau ve cong nang, tham mi va sy phu hop
voi cac dieu kien van hoa, xa hoi va moi truong;
S4. T churc va trien khai duoc cac buoc thiet ke tu phan tich hien trang, hinh thanh
y tuong, xay dung nhiem vu cho den thuc hien cac ban ve va thuyet minh chi tiet;
S5. Giam sat va danh gia dugc chat luong cua san pham thiet ke tur ban ve den
thi cong;
S6. Phoi hop dugc cac nen tang cong nghe pho bien, dac biet la cong nghe
thong tin trong qua trinh thiet ke;
S7. Co nang lurc ngoai ngur bac 4/6 Khung nang lurc ngoai ngur cua Viet Nam.
3.Murc d tu chu va trach nhiem (R)
R1. Cap nhat va san sang cai tien nham thich urng linh hoat voi cac thay doi
va xu huong phat trien cua moi truong hanh nghe;
R3. The hien trach nhiem xa hoi qua cac nghien curu, giai phap, sang kien quan
trong va huru ich trong hoat dong chuyen mon.

4. Vi tri viec lam ma sinh vien co the dam nhiem sau khi tot nghiep
Sinh vien tot nghiep tur nganh Kien truc (chuyen nganh Kien truc va Thiet ke
Canh quan) co the lam viec ? cac khoi nha nuoc cung nhu tu nhan va phi chinh phu,
tai cac co quan va doanh nghiep hoat dong trong linh vyc thiet ke hoac co lien quan
(cac don vi quan ly du an, chu dau tu, nha thau thi cong..). Cac vi tri cu the co the
ke den:
- Nhan vien thiet ke: Lam trong bo phan thiet ke cua to churc, doanh nghiep
tai cac phan doan cong viec khac nhau nhu xay dung y tuong, thiet ke chi tiet, dien
hoa 2D va 3D..., theo ca hai huong chuyen mon ve kien truc va canh quan.
- Chuyen vien sang tao: Nhan vien cua bo phan chuyen trach trong viec tim
toi va dua ra cac y turong dot pha va co kha nang ap dung.
- Giam doc thiet ke: Chiu trach nhiem chinh trong viec xay dung va hoan thien
cac y tuong thiet ke, tir nhung phac thao ban dau den het qua trinh trien khai.
- Quan ly ky thuat: Theo doi quy trinh va kiem tra chat luong cac ban ve thiet
ke theo cac tieu chuan, quy chuan xay dung co lien quan.
- Giam sat cong truong: Phu trach viec thi cong cong trinh theo dung thiet ké
va de xuat huong xir ly khi co van de nay sinh tai cong truong.
- Quan ly dy an: Tham gia cung chu dau tu trong viec lap ke hoach va nhiem
vu cho dy an, lam viec voi cac don vi tu van thiét ke cung nha thau thi cong trong
qua trinh trien khai.
- Chuyen vien tham dinh: Lam viec tai cac to churc co churc nang tham dinh
thiet ke.
to churc va doanh nghiep trong linh vyc kien truc va canh quan.
5. Kha nang hoc tap, nang cao trinh do sau khi tot nghiep
- Sinh vien tot nghiep sau khi di lam mot thoi gian co the thi sat hach de 1ay
chung chi hanh nghe trong linh vuc thiet ke kien truc, canh quan, thiet ke do thi.
-Sinh vien tot nghiep cuing co the theo hoc tiep cac khoa dao tao sau dai hoc
tai cac co so dao tao trong nuoc va quoc te ve cac thiet ke kien truc, canh quan, quan
tri do thi, quy hoach do thi, thiet ke do thi, quan ly du an, quan ly do thi..., dong thoi
tham gia giang day tai cac co so dao tao dai hoc ve kien truc, thiet ke canh quan...
